subject: 二层文殊菩萨（四臂形）
prompt:
Create ONE high-resolution photorealistic reference-guided reconstruction of the SINGLE specific Yingxian Wooden Pagoda sculpture in the attached reference, not a generic Buddhist statue. Portrait 1024x1536. Strict centered straight frontal near-orthographic camera at sculpture mid-height, symmetrical framing, FULL requested figure and attached base with 5% margin, no cropping. Neutral light-gray seamless studio backdrop, soft even diffuse illumination, sharp face and exact fingers, all in focus. Preserve the exact sculpted facial proportions, eyes, smile, body pose, garment folds, headdress, number of arms, hand positions and visible iconographic details of this specific reference. Material is realistic handmade ancient painted clay sculpture, mineral pigments and gilding, NEVER living human skin, wax, glossy plastic or cartoon/CGI. Clear shape separation suitable for 3D modeling. Isolate from temple, other figures, columns, halos not actually present, offerings and photographic clutter. No captions, lettering, watermark, panels or collage. Image is an AI interpretation, not documentary evidence; metadata outside image will say this. Subject-specific visual observations: Important: this particular photographed statue has FOUR ARMS, preserve exactly four, not two! Outer two arms spread near shoulders elbows bent palms upward; inner RIGHT viewer LEFT raised at chest finger circle, inner LEFT viewer RIGHT palm up at lap. Crown red gold green jewel, pale worn face, blue shawl yellow knee garment necklace green belt. Crosslegged on vivid lotus. Include small reclining BLUE LION supporting lotus, front lion head open mouth curled mane, compact geometric tier base. Do not enlarge animal into huge mount. Match photo anatomy and attachments.
HYPOTHETICAL PRE-WEATHERING appearance: depict this exact sculpture freshly completed, before deterioration. Repair only damage, keep all original geometry. Continuous CLEAN paint surfaces, intact gilding where evidenced, NO weathering, NO dirt speckles, NO dark stains, NO chips, NO cracks, NO peeling, NO patina. Existing pale exposed ground patches on face/chest that clearly interrupt gilding should become continuous subdued gold. Preserve subtle handmade clay grain and brush texture, not distressed texture. Conservatively reconstruct only colors evidenced by surviving pigment; no arbitrary elaborate patterns, ornaments, fantasy jewels or newly invented objects. This is plausible pre-weathering appearance, not a claim of verified original Liao paint.
